name: Yolŋu
notes: A related group of clans/language varieties of northeast Arnhem Land, Northern Territory. Not interchangeable with "Aboriginal Australians" generally — a distinct people among the >250 language groups on the continent, researched separately here from Warlpiri, Anangu, Tiwi, and Arrernte, which are genuinely different cultures/regions, not variants of one. Non-state, clan-based (bäpurru) sociopolitical organization — no centralized polity ever existed here, and this absence is itself the documented pattern, not a data gap; no Polity entity is modeled for this batch.
